info.title: Pigeonpost back office API
info.summary: Staff-only reads over accounts, handles, mailboxes, organizations, plans and the audit log, and the credits proxy.
info.description:
For Piyote staff only. Every operation needs a person (never an API key, a connector or a
mailbox token) holding one of the staff roles it names (`x-pigeonpost-roles`), from the
postbox's `staff_roles` table; the configured platform owner always holds `owner`.

Step-up (`x-pigeonpost-step-up`): `none` for the overview; `read` for personal data, where a
strong sign-in (`acr` in the configured list) up to an hour old suffices; `write` for anything
that changes state, which keeps the configured window (10 minutes in production). A refusal
is `401 step_up_required` with `details.acr_values` and `details.max_age`.

Every read of personal data and every write appends to the platform audit log
(`x-pigeonpost-audit`, actor kind `human`) in the same transaction as the read; nothing is
returned without the record. Message bodies are never read. Push tokens, store and provider
references, org API keys and IBANs are masked server-side; key material, capability hashes and
domain verification tokens are never selected.

Lists are paged: `limit` and an opaque `cursor`; `next_cursor` is `null` on the last page.

The credits operations are proxied to saas_be marketplace credits/finance with a server-side
token (`POSTBOX_SAAS_FINANCE_URL`, `POSTBOX_SAAS_FINANCE_TOKEN_FILE`); unconfigured or not
answering is `503 finance_unavailable`. Their bodies are saas_be's.

memberToken.description: Keycloak member access token for a signed-in person. Its validated `auth_time` and `acr` decide step-up.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request (`invalid_json`, `invalid_request`, `invalid_cursor`) or refused by saas_be (`finance_refused`).

Unauthorized.description: No valid credential (`unauthorized`), or a strong sign-in is needed (`step_up_required`, with `details.acr_values` and `details.max_age`).

Forbidden.description: Not a person (`human_required`), not holding a role this operation names (`staff_required`), or step-up not configured (`step_up_unavailable`).

Conflict.description: saas_be refused this in the record's current state (`finance_conflict`).

Unavailable.description: The finance service is not configured or not answering (`finance_unavailable`).

counts.description: accounts, signups_today, signups_7d, active_accounts_30d, handles, mailboxes, orgs_active, nests_running, open_reviews, open_reports, publisher_applications, hosted_jobs_failed_24h, charges_refused.

iban.description: Masked; the last four digits only.

amount_cents.description: USD cents; positive adds credit. At most $10,000 either way.

idempotency_key.description: Made when the form opens; a resubmitted form adjusts once.
